title: Website: This portfolio site
pitch: This site: a Next.js portfolio with dynamic routing, case studies, and image slideshows.
description: This website you're on right now. Built with Next.js to showcase my software, game development, and art projects, with dynamically routed project pages, image slideshows, and a curated homepage instead of a flat list of thumbnails. It's also the project I keep iterating on whenever I want to try something new in the frontend.
